timing: After full canonical reading and paper derivation; before new executable algebra controls. These are registered verification predictions, not claims of prior blind mathematical forecasts.
mechanism: Physical reciprocal convolution on the actual pair, with its own complex Mellin normalization; test its L2 source-range contract and full same-P forward return.

predictions.claim: The actual all-pass phase and both translated components give a single sine-square factor, not a sum of independent moduli.
Source-specific whole-pair reciprocal preimage is not in L2 for every fixed positive convolution time; a dyadic weighted-mass lower bound supplies the discriminator.
Complex Mellin-normalized forward convolution preserves the two selected evaluations and hence the inherited reflected form; modulus-only normalization does not.
At convolution time m^-1 the forward return to the unchanged P has o(1) full-form cost, with all cross terms; this supplies no favorable sign.
Planted axis-rotation, phase-loss, missing cross-term, and commuting-compression errors are detected by exact finite controls.
